# Impact across multiple GitHub products including Actions, Pages, and Copilot products.

## What Changed

Nov 11, 21:21 UTC Resolved - On November 11, 2026, from 20:05 to 21:02 UTC, customers experienced delayed or failed Actions workflow starts, webhook errors and delivery delays, slower GitHub Apps API requests, and reduced availability of Copilot features, including Code Review. GitHub Pages builds were also delayed. Nearly all GitHub Actions runs triggered between 20:18 and 20:55 UTC were delayed or failed, leaving approximately 3.4 million partially created runs that are being canceled. No GitHub Pages deployments completed during the incident. In the Central US data residency stamp, between 20:06 and 20:50 UTC, about 63% of webhook API requests failed and 27% of deliveries were not recorded; those deliveries reached their destinations but remain unavailable to view or redeliver. Between approximately 20:20 and 21:00 UTC, Copilot code review on github.com completed 87% fewer reviews than normal and some other Copilot features were also unavailable. The disruption was caused by an Azure Cosmos DB regional outage affecting database accounts used by these services.
